contributions.title: kgateway_build_info Prometheus metric
contributions.summary: Added a build-info metric (version, revision, Go version, OS/arch) so operators can tell which build every pod is running. Shipped in kgateway v2.5.0-beta.2; the maintainer extended it into a reusable metrics.NewInfo helper.

contributions.title: Fix flaky HTTP server startup in tests
contributions.summary: Replaced a ~0.5 s retry loop with a 5 s readiness poll and made test setup clean up before failing, fixing intermittent failures on the slow macOS CI runner (issue #1445).

contributions.title: Ginkgo unit tests for executor metrics
contributions.summary: 20 specs covering every pod-phase transition, label sanitising and registration error paths: 100% of sparkpod_metrics.go, plus a fix for a wrong executor failure-count log message. LGTM from a reviewer, waiting for approval.

contributions.title: RBAC metadata test for every capability
contributions.summary: Checks that every tool, prompt, resource and resource template across all 12 toolsets declares valid RBAC metadata, using a real cluster inspector. All 14 CI checks green on the first run (issue #1435).

contributions.title: Root-caused a “flaky” test
contributions.summary: Showed that a reported flaky failure on another contributor's PR was a real merge-order bug, reproduced it and suggested the fix. The author confirmed it, applied the fix and closed the issue as root-caused.

contributions.title: Workload scaler: count pods by state
contributions.summary: Assigned by a maintainer. Proposed a podStates option (pod phases plus Ready) so the workload scaler can ignore pods that aren't ready yet; waiting on design sign-off before coding.

contributions.title: Migrate the API reference docs generator
contributions.summary: Evaluated crd-ref-docs against genref with sample output and field-accuracy numbers, and recommended crd-ref-docs for the maintainer's decision.
